header_desc: Measure your hardware performance and get a NOMAD Score to see how well your system runs offline services.

errors.failed_submit_repo: Failed to submit benchmark to repository

alerts.ai_required_desc: A full benchmark requires {{name}} to be installed to measure AI inference performance. You can still run a System-only benchmark without AI.
alerts.partial_benchmark_desc: This benchmark only tested system performance (AI was not tested). The NOMAD Score may be lower than a full benchmark. We recommend running a full benchmark before sharing.
alerts.shared_anon_msg: Your benchmark has been shared anonymously to the NOMAD hardware repository. Thank you for contributing!
alerts.shared_with_tag_msg: Your benchmark has been shared with builder tag "{{tag}}" to the NOMAD hardware repository. Thank you for contributing!

tooltips.partial_score: This score reflects only system tests (CPU, memory, disk). AI inference was not tested. Run a full benchmark for a complete NOMAD Score.
tooltips.full_score: The NOMAD Score combines CPU, memory, disk I/O, and AI inference performance into a single number from 0 to 100.
tooltips.community_sharing: Help other NOMAD users know what hardware works best! Benchmark results include CPU model, memory, disk speeds, and AI performance. No personal data or IP addresses are ever shared.

score_card.partial_explainer: This score is based on <1>{{label}}</1>. For a complete NOMAD Score, run a full benchmark including the AI inference test.
score_card.full_explainer: The NOMAD Score reflects your system's overall readiness for running offline applications, search indexing, and AI workloads.

community.heading: NOMAD Hardware Database
community.intro: Contribute your benchmark results to the public NOMAD hardware repository. This helps other builders know what kind of performance to expect from similar hardware.
community.confirm_partial_submit: This is a partial benchmark (not all tests were run). Are you sure you want to share it?

ai_perf.title: {{name}} Performance
ai_perf.disclaimer: AI inference speed depends on your CPU/GPU, RAM speed, and model size. Higher is better.
ai_perf.not_tested_msg: AI performance was not tested in this benchmark run.

no_results.title: No Benchmark Results
no_results.desc: Run a benchmark to test your hardware performance and see how well your system handles offline AI and system tasks.

score_reveal.score_summary: System scored {{cpu}} CPU, {{mem}} memory, {{read}} disk read, {{write}} disk write.
